pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark tan regions exhibit complex stellate geometries with high-frequency jagged edges and sharp pixel-level transitions. The spatial area of individual patches is highly variable, with several exhibiting acute, leaf-like projections.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological graph characterized by narrow pathways (approx. 5-15% of patch width) and frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, uniform mane is visible along the dorsal neck ridge, producing a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette consisting of dense, vertical hair-bundle clusters.
